canonical_project: Oman Data Park Duqm data centre
notes: DCD reported the ODP-funded Duqm data center was expected online in December 2017 for SEZAD, and ODP now lists Duqm among its Level 3 in-country data centres. 2024 market release says ODP's Duqm facility was built to Uptime Tier III standards; MW capacity not disclosed.
